body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Necrotic Damage and suppress one ordinary magical Movement bonus, up to 1 unit, until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Also suppress 1 point of ordinary concealment benefit on it until the start of your next turn.
On a hit, end the chosen Movement bonus rather than suppress it.

rider.title: Rite - Hex
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: on a hit, bind the target. Trigger: it receives an ordinary beneficial magical effect. Echo: impose -1 on its next Success Die before your next turn.
